css: h1, .home-title, .game-title, .modal-title { text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.5), 0 0 30px rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.25); } .home-title::after { content: ' ❄️'; } .nav-btn.active { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.45); } .game-card:hover { border-color: rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.5); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.18); } .chart-bar-fill, .history-bar { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e63946, #2ecc71); } .toast { border-color: rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.4); } ::selection { background: #e63946; color: #0b1118; }
